title: Transcendental Hilbert-Kunz Multiplicities
summary: We prove that ordinary Hilbert-Kunz multiplicity can be transcendental. More precisely, over every uncountable algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>2$, there exists a normal standard graded domain $S$ and an $S_+$-primary homogeneous ideal $I\subseteq S$ such that $e_{\rm HK}(IS_{S_+})$ is transcendental.
